legacy_evidence_mapping.prototype_staging_and_faults: regression and sizing seeds only; no atomicity, full-RIB, concurrency, or declared stale-window evidence
legacy_evidence_mapping.routing_model_attack_reachability_simula: opaque fixed topology/scenario regression; the old headline delivery and exposure curves came from separate lanes and are not a joint E4 frontier

workload.routeviews_parser: bgpdump 1.6.2-2; rightmost scalar AS-path element; multi-member AS_SET tails excluded

visibility_paths.purpose: status-specific dual-stack characterization for Section II.B; separate from the broad IPv4 construction workload

path_definition.root_selection: identify the nearest strict containing eligible root and retain the endpoint only when that root is canonical and unambiguous; a nearer non-CIDR or conflicting root is an exclusion barrier with no fallback
path_definition.IPv4_chain: ALLOCATED PA -> one or more SUB-ALLOCATED PA objects -> ASSIGNED PA
path_definition.IPv6_chain: ALLOCATED-BY-RIR -> one or more ALLOCATED-BY-LIR objects -> ASSIGNED
path_definition.registry_indirect: at least one eligible intermediate allocation object strictly between root and assigned endpoint
path_definition.registry_containment_depth: maximum number of eligible intermediate ranges in a strictly nested root-to-endpoint chain; this is registry structure, not an organization count, communication-hop count, proven delegation count, or issuer-knowledge distance
path_definition.depth_non_laminar_audit: compare the longest strictly nested chain with the total number of clean eligible ranges containing the endpoint; inequality marks overlapping ranges that cannot be interpreted as one path
path_definition.exact_observed: both exact prefixes have nonempty scalar origin sets and neither prefix is terminal-path ambiguous
path_definition.potential_conflict_candidate: registry-indirect exact-observed pair whose root and endpoint origin sets are disjoint
path_definition.three_handle_subset: candidate with one exact RIPE org handle at root, one containing intermediate object, and endpoint, all pairwise distinct

independent_tree_crosscheck.implementation: independent compact range catalogue, longest-prefix root lookup, and per-root interval prefix-max hop indexes

visibility_paths.schema_note: the compact CSV explicitly records the IPv6 three-handle count as zero; the primary JSON Counter omits that zero-valued key
visibility_paths.claim_boundary: registry/BGP data identify conditional route-side candidates only; they do not establish issuer knowledge, communication-channel absence, permission, ROA state, route legitimacy, causation, or allocation-tree prevalence

enforcement.generic_fixture_false_flag_explanation: thirty audited removal snapshots and one auxiliary copied decision retain static expected_da=Explicit while the transition-specific oracle is Delegated; independently recomputed state, raw FRR action, stored decision, and enforcement checks pass

origin_churn.timestamp_source: one persistent Python time.monotonic_ns() helper; UTC timestamps are metadata only
origin_churn.da_state_source: DA agent decision installed as an FRR route-map action; not FRR's native rpkiValidationState
origin_churn.claim_boundary: the open arm precompiled both endpoint origins into route actions before handoff; this archived run is permanently pilot_only and must not support an operational-benefit claim

deployment_frontier.topology_upstream_provenance: unreconstructed; manuscript treats the hash-bound graph as an opaque fixed model input
deployment_frontier.manuscript_scenario_set_description: frozen 589-AS conventional-ROV scenario set of unreconstructed upstream provenance
deployment_frontier.manuscript_unit_definition: candidate-bearing root-origin unit: a synthetic root-origin ASN selected from an observed root prefix, not a verified resource holder
deployment_frontier.within_holder_selection: namespace-separated SHA-256 ranks select holder, then one root, one distinct delegate within root, and one leaf within (holder, root, delegate)
deployment_frontier.primary_deployment_orders: random seeds 1-5, averaged within sample unit at intermediate levels
deployment_frontier.competition_scope: the routing model evaluates one same-prefix eligible unlisted origin; attack-reachability separately evaluates one deterministic same-length sibling; strictly more-specific routes exceed the configured maxLength and are rejected by both enforcing policies; broader maxLength not evaluated
deployment_frontier.campaign_max_length: DA object and exact-child ROA use selected leaf length; aggregate-only ROA uses root length
deployment_frontier.delegate_bootstrap_unit: candidate-bearing root-origin sample unit, resampled within four sampling strata after within-unit random-order averaging
deployment_frontier.delegate_interval_type: pointwise stratified paired rescaled bootstrap for the 691-unit finite frame with SRSWOR finite-population correction
deployment_frontier.competition_target: 200 selected synthetic units after fixed 161:177:179:174 stratum-share standardization; unselected units have no post-sample competitor outcome
deployment_frontier.competition_interval_type: ordinary within-stratum paired bootstrap stability interval without finite-population correction; not 691-frame confidence
deployment_frontier.partial_adoption_interval_conditioning: delegate intervals quantify finite-frame unit-sampling uncertainty; competition intervals summarize selected-unit resampling stability; both condition on five fixed deployment schedules and omit order-assignment uncertainty

deployment_grid_extension.purpose: fill the seven missing decile cells for the two active routing-model panels while preserving the frozen routing-model campaign
deployment_grid_extension.scope_semantics: coverage is the share of this one fixed set assigned the modeled upgraded policy; 0% means none of the 589 ASes and 100% means all 589 ASes, with no claim beyond this set
deployment_grid_extension.historical_manifest_string_status: immutable historical scenario label in the hash-bound formal manifest; it does not establish that the 589-AS set is measured, current, representative, or an estimate of Internet conditions
deployment_grid_extension.extension_factorization: 200 selected units x 7 new coverage points x 5 fixed random orders x 2 lanes
deployment_grid_extension.random_order_role: five fixed within-unit blocks retained for descriptive trajectories and averaged within unit before interval calculation; they are not independent units

deployment_outcomes_display.panel_b: delivery to the eligible unlisted origin under S²-ROV, Aggregate-only ROV, and Exact-match ROV
